name: @xfufu/dsh-auto-continue
description: Automatic turn-level resume for DeepSeek Harness sessions: continues after transient model-request failures, merges provider outages into one storm, and always yields to a manual stop.
author: xfufu

scripts.verify: node test.mjs && node storm.mjs && node replay.mjs && node verify-pack.mjs
scripts.prepack: node -e "const p=require('./package.json');if(!p.name.startsWith('@xfufu/'))throw new Error('unexpected scope: '+p.name);if(p.repository.url.indexOf('kemomimi12/dsh-auto-continue')<0)throw new Error('repository must point at the canonical repo');console.log('prepack checks passed:',p.name+'@'+p.version)"
